Why go: a short canopy course on the quiet side of the island

This course is a good fit if you are staying on the west or south-west coast, where most other activities mean a long drive. The free transfer zone covers Lipa Noi, Nathon, Taling Ngam and Bang Por, and the whole outing takes under three hours, so it fits before a sunset on the west-coast beaches.

The course mixes ziplines with four sky bridges, spiral stairs and an abseil. It is shorter than the big jungle parks, which suits younger riders and first-timers.

Programme A or B

Programme B is the shorter loop with 5 ziplines and suits younger children and nervous first-timers. Programme A adds 3 more lines and 2 more platforms for a slightly longer session at little extra cost. Both include the 4 sky bridges, spiral stairs and the 15 m abseil, and the longest line runs up to 300 m. The optional sky bicycle, a 140 m ride along a cable, is booked on the day. Guests from Chaweng, Lamai or Bophut should allow for the transfer fee and about 45 minutes each way.

Who it suits

  • Families with younger children who meet the 20 kg minimum.
  • Guests staying in Lipa Noi, Nathon or Taling Ngam.
  • First-timers who want to try ziplining without a long session.

Who should choose something else

  • Guests in Chaweng or Lamai who want a longer course: the Silver or Golden jungle zipline includes transfer from the main areas.
  • Anyone over 105 kg.

Good to know

  • Safety: double-lock lanyards mean you are always clipped in; follow the guide on every platform.
  • West-coast sunsets: book the 14:00 session and you are back in time for sunset at Lipa Noi.
  • Booking: online booking for tomorrow closes at midnight Thai time.
